latestVersion.changelog: SIM-5499: per-market position cap (max_buys_per_market, default 1) checked against held positions before entry; run summary prints a per-location skip-reason breakdown. Risk-reducing by default; set 0 for the old unbounded DCA.

raw_record.summary: Trade Polymarket weather markets using NOAA (US) and Open-Meteo (international) forecasts via Simmer API. Inspired by gopfan2's weather trading approach. Use when user wants to trade temperature markets, automate weather bets, check forecasts, or run weather-based strategies.
